title: Quote and Proposal Acceptance
summary: Turn a quote or proposal into a binding order with a deposit and basic terms.
useWhen: You have sent a quote, estimate or proposal and need the customer's signed acceptance before you start work or order materials.
watchOuts: Attach or reference the exact quote version. Price disputes often come from different versions of a quote.

If the customer is a consumer and you sign the deal at their home, the FTC Cooling-Off Rule may give them three business days to cancel. It applies to many sales of $25 or more, and some states extend it. Include the required notice where it applies.
Say whether the deposit is refundable. Some states limit non-refundable deposits for home improvement work.

variables.label: Summary of what is included
variables.help: Short description. The attached quote controls the details.

variables.label: Total price
variables.help: Total quoted price, including taxes if applicable.

variables.label: Deposit due at acceptance
variables.help: Amount due to book the work.

variables.label: Is the deposit refundable?
variables.help: Check state limits for consumer and home-improvement work.

variables.label: Quote valid until
variables.help: The customer must accept by this date.

variables.label: Signed at the customer's home or a temporary location (consumer sale)?
variables.help: If on, adds the FTC three-day cancellation notice.

variables.label: Governing law (state)
variables.help: Two-letter code of the state whose law governs this agreement. Usually where the parties or the work are located.

sections.title: 1. Acceptance
2. Price and payment
sections.body: Total price: {{total_price}}. Deposit due now: {{deposit}} ({{deposit_refundable}}). Balance: {{balance_terms}}. Changes to scope require a signed change order and may change the price.

sections.title: Schedule
sections.body: Estimated start date: {{start_date}}. Dates are estimates and may be affected by weather, material availability, permits or Customer delays. Provider will keep Customer informed.

sections.title: 3. Validity
sections.body: This quote can be accepted until {{valid_until}}. After that, Provider may revise pricing.

sections.title: 4. Basic terms
sections.body:
- Provider will perform the work in a good and workmanlike manner and follow applicable laws.
- Customer will provide reasonable access and information needed for the work.
- Provider's liability is limited to the amount paid under this acceptance, except where the law does not allow a limit.
- Customer service address: {{customer_address}}.

sections.title: 5. Notice of right to cancel
sections.body: **You, the buyer, may cancel this transaction at any time prior to midnight of the third business day after the date of this transaction.** To cancel, send or deliver a signed and dated notice of cancellation, or any other written notice, to {{provider_name}} at the address on the quote before that deadline. If you cancel, any payments you made will be returned within 10 business days. (FTC Cooling-Off Rule, 16 CFR Part 429. A separate cancellation form must also be provided where the rule applies.)

sections.title: 6. General terms
sections.body:
- **Whole agreement.** This document (with any attachments named in it) is the parties' entire agreement on its subject and replaces earlier discussions and drafts.
- **Changes.** It can only be changed in a writing signed by all parties.
- **Severability.** If a court finds any part unenforceable, that part is limited to the minimum extent needed and the rest stays in effect.
- **No waiver.** Not enforcing a term once is not a waiver of it later.
- **Notices.** Notices must be in writing and delivered by hand, by a recognized courier, by certified mail, or by email to the addresses in this document (or a later address a party gives in writing). Email notice is effective when sent unless the sender receives a bounce-back.
- **Governing law.** The law of the state of {{governing_state}} governs this agreement, without regard to conflict-of-law rules.
- **Counterparts and electronic signatures.** This agreement may be signed in counterparts and electronically. Each party consents to doing business electronically under the federal E-SIGN Act and the state's version of the Uniform Electronic Transactions Act (or New York's Electronic Signatures and Records Act). An electronic signature has the same effect as a handwritten one.

sections.title: Signatures
sections.body:
By signing below, each party agrees to this document.

**Accepted by Customer** — {{customer_name}}

[[sig:customer]]

Printed name: [[name:customer]]
Title (if signing for a company): [[text:customer:Title]]
Date: [[date:customer]]

**Provider** — {{provider_name}}

[[sig:provider]]

Printed name: [[name:provider]]
Title (if signing for a company): [[text:provider:Title]]
Date: [[date:provider]]

disclaimer: This is a starting template from the Massless open contract library. It is not legal advice, and using it does not create an attorney-client relationship. Laws vary by state and change over time. Have a licensed attorney in your state review it before you sign.
